manual_review.reviewed_by: AF, by reading the sampled titles and casts
manual_review.github_verdict: the 'questions' are mostly spec text, my own self-test issue (#75), and developer design docs. Reading 15 samples found 0 that ask anyone to check a specific token.
manual_review.farcaster_verdict: real pain signals exist, and they are about honeypots, not ownership: 'farcade token looks like a honeypot', 'I can't possibly be the only one on FC getting honeypot tokens', 'honeypot tracker on base that not only checks apparent honeypots'.
manual_review.pain_topic: honeypot / can I sell this token
manual_review.mismatch: the stated pain is honeypot (a live buy+sell test), which AF does NOT perform and must not claim. AF proves ownership/mint/upgradeability at a block. That is a real but narrower question, and the case studies already quote the free honeypot scanner beside it instead of copying its answer.
manual_review.self_test_leak: issue #75 appears in GitHub results for 'token audit' — AF counting its own issue is exactly the contamination the funnel excludes

segments.segment: token creator who wants to look clean
segments.problem: buyers ask them for proof of ownership / no-mint
segments.why: AF reports the control surface; it refuses to certify, so it cannot give the assurance they are really buying

segments.problem: wants to know who can change what, at which block
segments.why: this is exactly what the engine reads, and the hash makes it diffable

segments.segment: user deciding whether to buy a token
segments.problem: is the owner able to mint or rug
segments.why: owner, owner type, supply and upgradeability answer the question; honeypot stays unread and is labelled so

segments.segment: community moderator vetting a token before recommending it
segments.problem: needs a citable artefact, not a green badge
segments.why: a block-stamped, hashed report is exactly what a moderator can paste

github_rate_limit: a second run of the same queries returned total=None/sampled=0 (search API rate limit, unauthenticated budget). Zeros from a failed call are not evidence of absent demand, so the earlier counts are kept and the failure is recorded here.
